description: Find the closed faces of a graph and turn them into Spaces. With Flow Live on, each face becomes a REAL Space on canvas — this is how a traced graph becomes rooms, since Live segments alone are ignored by auto room detection.
instructions:
Takes a GRAPH as JSON and returns its closed faces as polygons.

WITH FLOW LIVE ON each face is materialised as a REAL Space on canvas. This is the node that turns a traced floor plan into rooms: a Network node materialises the graph as canvas nodes and segments, but those segments are tagged flow-owned and auto room detection deliberately SKIPS them (otherwise the flow would read back its own output and oscillate), so walls alone never produce Spaces. Wire the same graph into this node as well and the rooms appear. Feed it a clean planar graph — run Fit Lines first so the sides are straight, junctions are shared and stray tails are trimmed, or faces will leak into one another.

INPUT: graph takes { "nodes": [{ "id", "x", "y" }, ...], "edges": [{ "from_node_id", "to_node_id" }, ...] } — coordinates in metres, local to the anchor. Wire Graph Geometry val-graph, or Skeleton val-branches, into valin-graph.

OUTPUT: val-polygons publishes the result as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list, which a Polygon node accepts directly.

Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
